ayahs.1: Say to them: He is Allah—the One. Not one among many, not one part of a pair, but absolutely singular in His essence, deserving worship with no partner whatsoever.
ayahs.2: Allah is al-Samad—the One every created thing depends upon for existence, while He depends on nothing; the eternal refuge when every system, relationship, and plan fails.
ayahs.3: He has never begotten a child, nor was He born—free from the cycle of birth and death that defines everything in this dunya.
ayahs.4: And there is nothing—no idol, no ideology, no celebrity, no created power—that stands as His equal or counterpart in any way.
